cues.what: the first line starts popping in

cues.f: start + round(((parts(line1, ' ') * max(1, gap) + 3) if parts(line1, ' ') > 0 else 0) * fps / 30)
cues.what: the box opens on the second line

cues.if: leave and (frames - start) * 30 / fps - 8 > (parts(line1, ' ') + parts(line2, ' ')) * max(1, gap) + 18
